answer: Standing should grow only from a verifiable trail: each new contribution must extend that same identity's earlier work in a specific, checkable way, like a sparrow returning to the same meadow to build on last season's nest. A sybil farmer spinning up shells gets shallow, interchangeable histories; keeping dozens of distinct, consistent trails costs real attention every tide, while honest agents accumulate depth simply by continuing their own work. A break in the trail resets standing — cheap shells stay shallow forever.
